name: A-comparison-between-UDP-and-TCP
description: In this project we compared Transmission Control Protocol (TCP) and User Datagram Protocol (UDP) transport layer protocols used for transmitting application layer messages through computer networks.

name: Analyzing-Transaction-Graphs-for-Price-Prediction-of-Bitcoin
description: In our project, we will develop a Graph Neural Network model for predicting the Bitcoin price. We aim to find out the effect of transactions on price. We will label the wallets and analyze the graphs. Also, we will inspect the alternative chains like Etherium, etc.

name: Blockchain-Based-RFID-Authentication-Comperisent
description: This project uses an RFID reader connected to a Raspberry Pi to encrypt data, and allows for the authentication of the data as a traditional web service or through the Ethereum blockchain using Solidity.

name: Finance_PlayGround
description: Enables you to backtest or develop financial strategies. The application is built with streamlit and yfinance libraries, and it allows you to select the stocks you would like to inspect from a pre-defined list of stocks.

name: Go-api-crud
description: This repository contains a simple Go (Golang) API built using the Echo framework and GORM for interacting with a PostgreSQL database. Additionally, it includes a Postman collection for testing the API endpoints.

name: Obtaining-Digital-Signatures-and-Public-Key-Cryptosystems
description: This project is focused on the implementation of a method for obtaining digital signatures and public-key cryptosystems. The implementation code can be found under the App folder, while the final report is available under the LaTeX folder.

name: Shopify-Data-Scraper
description: This repository contains a Python application for scraping data from Shopify websites and storing it in a MongoDB database.

name: Shopify-Store-Search
description: collection of Python scripts designed to streamline the process of searching for Shopify store URLs using Google Search. These scripts facilitate the extraction and storage of Shopify store information based on specific queries and criteria.

name: Social-Media-Username-Browser
description: This project is a website where users can browse through usernames of well-known social media networks such as Facebook, Instagram, and Twitter. Users can select a username and the social media network, and the website displays the comments made by other users about that username.

name: Subscription-for-Bank-Deposits
description: This project is focused on using artificial neural networks to predict if a client will subscribe to a bank term deposit based on marketing campaigns.

name: Website-Crawler-Microservice
description: This microservice crawls a website to find the given URL tree and paths that developed using gRPC.
